class.name: sirius_hw_interfaces/SiriusWheelsHW
class.description: Topic-bridge hardware interface for the Sirius rover wheel drive system. Delegates velocity commands to the ODrive Python driver via relaxing_middleware and reads joint states from the driver.

class.name: sirius_hw_interfaces/SiriusManipHW
class.description: Topic-bridge hardware interface for the Sirius rover manipulator. Delegates position/velocity/effort commands to the Moteus/Roboszpon Python drivers and reads joint states from them.
